artifact_hashes.hash_note: SHA-256 of LF-normalised bytes (CRLF->LF), project convention pre_reg_guard._sha256_lf == receipts.sha256_lf. Full digests, untruncated. signals.py and engine.py match the values recorded in the g2_funding_level pre-registration, i.e. the collecting families were screened against these exact definitions.

hypothesis.statement: When a fast moving average leads a slow moving average, price momentum tends to persist.
hypothesis.expected_sign: positive mean forward return while SMA(20) > SMA(100) (long); negative forward return while SMA(20) < SMA(100), so a short position earns positive return
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: 7-day forward BTC returns are identically distributed across the SMA(20)>SMA(100) and SMA(20)<SMA(100) states; the MA-cross state carries no directional information.
hypothesis.falsification: Wrong if fast-above-slow days are not followed by relative strength and fast-below-slow days not by relative weakness. The direction is frozen and may not be flipped on a negative result.
hypothesis.role_note: Role feature, set in registry.yaml on 2026-06-13 and NOT reopened here. Edge-ineligible: recorded battery sharpe 0.2337 < candidate.edge.min_sharpe 0.30.
hypothesis.rationale_of_record: Fast/slow SMA crossover as a trend-persistence filter; tests whether MA-cross structure adds information beyond the SMA200 slope regime.

function_spec.name: Trend Regime (MA cross)
function_spec.hash_note: HASH-PINNED at Gate 6A.16. SHA-256 of LF-normalised bytes (pre_reg_guard._sha256_lf). verify_fn_hash aborts any run whose function bytes drift from this value. Pinning the hash does NOT admit the candidate: status remains SPECIFICATION_FROZEN_NOT_ADMITTED.
function_spec.implementation_obligation: The standalone decision function must accept a plain pd.Series (platform convention, stated verbatim in decision_function_g1_market_regime.py: do NOT import sig_market_regime from signals.py) and must be PROVEN behaviourally identical to sig_trend_regime(m, 20, 100) on the same close series by an equivalence test. Reimplementation is a hashing requirement, never a licence to reinterpret.

data_source.aux_note: Single-input signal. run_signal takes the unmodified close-only path; aux_series stays None.

sampling.daily_close_rule: last 1m bar of the UTC calendar day (resample('D').last())

completeness.interior_short_day_behaviour: NOT guarded — _assert_final_day_complete checks only the final day. The 7 known short days in the real corpus (2021-02-11, 2021-03-06, 2021-04-20, 2021-04-25, 2021-08-13, 2021-09-29, 2023-03-24) all predate the first forward run_date 2026-06-15 and cannot affect a forward observation.

parameter_tags.FAST: PLATFORM-ORIGIN (frozen) — SignalSpec.params in signals.py; the exact battery parameter and the one screened at 6A.15-PRE
parameter_tags.HOLD_DAYS: PLATFORM-CONV — unanimous 7 across all seven decision functions
parameter_tags.MIN_HISTORY: DERIVED — equals SLOW; the exact minimum at which the undefined-MA branch is unreachable. Not padded, not chosen.

function_spec.platform_new_note: EMPTY, and that is the point: no PLATFORM-NEW choice was required. Every value is either the frozen candidate's own, an existing platform convention, or mechanically derived. Unlike C3, this gate had nothing left to invent.
function_spec.flat_condition: SMA(20) exactly equals SMA(100) (measure-zero), or either moving average undefined — the latter made unreachable by MIN_HISTORY
function_spec.transformation: NONE. The position IS the raw signal. No shift, no re-signing, no threshold, no scaling.
function_spec.exit_rule: scheduled exit at entry_date + 7 calendar days; no early exit; signal re-evaluated daily but a new trade opens only when no trade is open
function_spec.trade_counting_definition: one entry-to-exit pair is one trade; at most one open trade at a time

warm_up_semantics.derivation: rolling(SLOW, min_periods=SLOW) first yields a non-NaN value on row SLOW; SMA(FAST) is satisfied far earlier. MIN_HISTORY = SLOW = 100 is therefore the exact minimum.
enforced_twice: load_daily_closes raises DataUnavailableError when len(daily) < min_rows
run_signal re-checks len(closes_to_date) < min_history at its own boundary
warm_up_semantics.warm_up_is_never_observed: A run with insufficient history writes no run_log row at all, not a flat one.
warm_up_semantics.verified: V3.4 — zero undefined finals over every series length 100..400

declared_limitations.title: Rolling windows are row-indexed, not calendar-indexed
declared_limitations.detail: load_daily_closes ends in .dropna(), so the series holds only days present in the corpus. rolling(100) counts ROWS: a corpus gap makes the 100-row window silently span more than 100 calendar days.
declared_limitations.scope: Shared loader property; identical for every collecting family including g1_market_regime_sma200's SMA200.
declared_limitations.resolution: INHERITED DELIBERATELY, not resolved here. Changing it for one family would diverge this candidate from the platform.

declared_limitations.title: Short interior days pass through unguarded
declared_limitations.resolution: Declared; cannot affect a forward observation.

provenance_contract.input_digest_convention: RAW chunked SHA-256 (storage/manifest.py _sha256) per Parquet partition — NOT _sha256_lf, which normalises CRLF->LF and would corrupt a binary digest
provenance_contract.fail_closed: resolve_input_identity raises DataUnavailableError if a partition cannot be hashed; framework_hash raises if a framework file is missing. An unidentifiable input must fail, never be recorded as identified.

run_date_policy.note: Lockbox and immutable-gap run_dates are refused UNCONDITIONALLY, ahead of any authorization branch (gate 6B.3).

integrity_rules.no_lookahead: closes filtered to run_date inclusive before any computation (run_signal: closes[closes.index <= run_date]); all rolling windows trailing-only, no center=, no negative shift
integrity_rules.missing_data_policy: DataUnavailableError -> transient skip; NEVER recorded as a flat decision (gate 6B.1 defect B-02)
integrity_rules.manufactured_flat_hazard: CONFIRMED and CLOSED. Verified V5.1: a NaN close at run_date makes the frozen definition return 0.0 — it cannot distinguish absent data from a genuine flat view. Every guard therefore sits upstream at the runner/loader boundary, not in the decision function.
fail_closed_surface: run_date absent from close series -> DataUnavailableError
close present but NaN at run_date -> DataUnavailableError (explicit B-02 guard)
framework file missing -> raises, no fallback identity
run_date in lockbox or immutable gap -> refused unconditionally
integrity_rules.interior_gap_note: Interior corpus gaps cannot produce a NaN moving average: the loader drops missing days rather than delivering them as NaN. The manufactured-FLAT surface is therefore exactly two cases, both closed.
integrity_rules.incomplete_final_day_policy: rejected by the 1440-bar guard (gate 6B.1 defect B-01)
integrity_rules.fn_hash_enforcement: verify_fn_hash aborts any run whose decision-function bytes drift; a fn_hash_violation row is recorded. Active from the moment the file exists.

return_and_cost_convention.fill_convention: close-to-close per trade: entry_close_price and exit_close_price, both spot close
return_and_cost_convention.cost_convention: flat cost_bps per trade, charged ONCE
return_and_cost_convention.direction_convention: explicit +-1 column, CHECK-constrained — supports both long and short
return_and_cost_convention.maturity_rule: matures when trade_exits is written for the entry (UNIQUE(entry_id)); the trade_returns VIEW then serves the computed columns

rejected_specifications.reason: LONG-ONLY and hardcoded (direction = 1). This candidate is long_short; adopting it would silently discard every short trade.

Offline battery convention: per-turnover cost on every daily position change, horizon 1 day. It is the convention under which this family's recorded in-sample statistics were produced, and gate 6B.5 established it as a deliberately distinct registered Specification, not a defect.

return_and_cost_convention.is_vs_forward_comparability: NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE, declared explicitly. The Phase B SignalSpec for 'Trend Regime (MA cross)' sets no hold_days and therefore inherited engine.py's default hold_days = 1; forward collection uses HOLD_DAYS = 7. Different hold, different cost convention, different horizon. Any future comparison must say so.

The family's most serious recorded weakness. Not a candidate-gate criterion and does not block collection, but the single most likely way forward evidence disappoints.

NO IN-SAMPLE DSR OR BH-p EXISTS. Both NULL on the pinned run. Under section-16 R1, NULL is a hard failure — but the Validated gate is evaluated on FORWARD returns, so this does not block collection. It does mean there is no in-sample statistical prior.
LOW TRADE COUNT. 23 in-sample trades; n is small for a per-trade distribution. Already flagged in the registry.

PAIRWISE INDEPENDENCE MEASURED ON TRAIN POSITIONS, NOT FORWARD RETURNS. max_pairwise_r = 0.70 is enforced at Validated over forward returns (Proposal 1, implemented 2026-07-19). The 0.6030 recorded here does NOT guarantee the forward-return pair clears 0.70 against g1_market_regime_sma200. A real promotion risk, not a resolved matter.
TWO TREND FAMILIES COLLECTING SIMULTANEOUSLY. Permitted under the 6A.14 determination and quantified at 0.6030 — recorded so the choice is visible rather than incidental.

admission.what_admission_is_here: There is no `admitted` lifecycle state and no registry field marking a family as collecting — g2_funding_level has been collecting since 2026-08-26 with preregistration=null and a schema-identical entry. Collection is what happens BETWEEN candidate and validated, so this decision is a governance judgement recorded in prose. Its operative effect is that the wiring gate is unblocked.
admission.criteria_applied: check_candidate_gate re-evaluated on the RECORDED pinned run against current thresholds: E3_KNIFE_EDGE 1.00 >= 0.40, B_SENSITIVITY 1.00 >= 0.60, B_OOS_POSITIVE 0.8690 > 0 — identical to the three gate_results already in the ledger. check_hard_dq: (False, []). Clone 0.6030 < 0.90; collecting-family bar 0.6030 < 0.70. No new statistic was generated.
admission.feature_path_scope: min_sharpe, min_wf_agreement, min_loo_consistency, min_breakeven_bps, structural_sign_required, min_active_days, min_calendar_years and min_regimes all live under thresholds.yaml candidate.EDGE, and check_candidate_gate applies that block only if 'edge' in roles. This family is role=['feature'], so R1 (struct_sign_ok=False) and R3 (23 IS trades) are not criteria that apply to it — which is how it was admitted to candidacy on 2026-06-13 with struct_sign_ok already False.
admission.clone_is_a_pass_not_a_case: The 0.6030 result establishes that this family is not a duplicate. It establishes nothing about whether the signal works, and no part of this admission rests on it as evidence of merit.
admission.r2_precedent: g2_funding_level, the most recent admission (2026-08-26), was admitted to collection with dsr_prob=null and bh_p=null, deferring both to 'computed at the FROZEN n_trials=34 on forward returns'. NULL governance stats are not a bar to collection; they mean there is no in-sample statistical prior.
admission.risks_carried_forward: R1, R2, R3 and R4 are all carried unchanged into the promotion assessment, where they ARE adjudicated. R4 in particular — 0.6030 is a train-slice POSITION correlation and does not establish forward-return independence — is now recorded in the registry weakness itself so it cannot be lost.

U1_resolution.question: governance floors unchanged, or a family-specific threshold?
U1_resolution.finding: thresholds.yaml provides NO observation floor for a feature-role family: min_active_days and min_calendar_years sit under candidate.edge only. 'Floors unchanged' would leave this family with no floor at all, which is why every collecting family sets its own.
U1_resolution.decision: Adopt the platform-precedent floor. Introduce no tuned number. thresholds.yaml is NOT modified.
U1_resolution.minimum_trades_basis: Identical in g1_market_regime_sma200 and g2_funding_level, both feature-role. Not chosen for this family.
U1_resolution.direction_coverage_basis: Implied by the frozen long_short direction; supported by the already-recorded 6A.15-PRE train activity split of 804 long / 709 short. A coverage condition, not a threshold.
U1_resolution.deliberately_not_set: minimum_calendar_months_before_assessment — genuinely family-specific and genuinely divergent between precedents (60 for g1_market_regime_sma200, 12 for g2_funding_level). Choosing requires a trade-frequency derivation, which would be introducing a threshold from a derived quantity. Deferred as U-3.
